picks.name: MYTRON
picks.source_note: Already in your library (previously picked for "Propeller" in August). This is a new, distinct release on the same Multi Culti label.
picks.bio: "Ascorbic" (November 6, 2026, Multi Culti) is a new single from London-based producer MYTRON, a hardware-driven multi-instrumentalist known for psychedelic, leftfield-disco and dub-inflected grooves.
picks.why_listen: Warm, hardware-driven psychedelic groove -- a good lo-fi, head-nodding change of pace in a set.

picks.name: Chris Stevo
picks.source_note: Refuge Recordings already seeded. New artist discovery. Exact Bandcamp release-page link unconfirmable via search, so the purchase link uses the label's confirmed-live Bandcamp root.
picks.bio: "Tito's Groove" (October 30, 2026, Refuge Recordings) is a tech house-leaning EP from Australian DJ/producer Chris Stevo (Wollongong), whose prior work has landed on Interfonic and Motive Deep.
picks.why_listen: Rolling, percussive tech house with a deep-tech edge -- a solid groove-driver for a club-focused stretch of a set.
